title.en: Solubility equilibria of sparingly soluble salts

heading.en: Why does a white solid suddenly appear?

hook.en: Mix silver nitrate with salt water and a white solid appears at once. The *solubility* product tells us exactly when a precipitate will form.
hook.kn: ಸಿಲ್ವರ್ ನೈಟ್ರೇಟನ್ನು ಉಪ್ಪು ನೀರಿನೊಂದಿಗೆ ಬೆರೆಸಿದಾಗ ತಕ್ಷಣ ಬಿಳಿ ಘನ ಕಾಣಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಅವಕ್ಷೇಪ ಯಾವಾಗ ಉಂಟಾಗುತ್ತದೆ ಎಂದು ದ್ರಾವ್ಯತಾ ಗುಣಲಬ್ಧ ಹೇಳುತ್ತದೆ.

title.en: Write Ksp for a sparingly soluble salt
Relate Ksp to molar solubility s
Explain precipitation and the common ion effect on solubility

say.en: Mix silver nitrate with salt water and a white solid appears at once. The solubility product tells us exactly when a precipitate will form. In this lesson: Write Ksp for a sparingly soluble salt.
Relate Ksp to molar solubility s.
Explain precipitation and the common ion effect on solubility.

body.en: For a *sparingly soluble* salt in a saturated solution, $AgCl(s) ⇌ Ag^+ + Cl^-$ gives $K_{sp} = [Ag^+][Cl^-] = s^2$. For a salt $M_xX_y$, $K_{sp} = x^x y^y s^{x+y}$: for Ag₂CrO₄ it is 4s³ and for Ca₃(PO₄)₂ it is 108s⁵.
body.kn: ಅಲ್ಪ ದ್ರಾವ್ಯ ಲವಣದ ಸಂತೃಪ್ತ ದ್ರಾವಣದಲ್ಲಿ AgCl ಗೆ Ksp = [Ag⁺][Cl⁻] = s². MₓXᵧ ಲವಣಕ್ಕೆ Ksp = xˣ yʸ s^(x+y).

narration.en: For a sparingly soluble salt in a saturated solution, AgCl(s) ⇌ Ag^+ + Cl^- gives Ksp = [Ag^+][Cl^-] = s^2. For a salt MxXy, Ksp = x^x y^y s^x+y: for Ag₂CrO₄ it is 4s³ and for Ca₃(PO₄)₂ it is 108s⁵.
narration.kn: ಅಲ್ಪ ದ್ರಾವ್ಯ ಲವಣದ ಸಂತೃಪ್ತ ದ್ರಾವಣದಲ್ಲಿ AgCl ಗೆ Ksp = [Ag⁺][Cl⁻] = s². MₓXᵧ ಲವಣಕ್ಕೆ Ksp = xˣ yʸ s^(x+y).

say.en: For a sparingly soluble salt in a saturated solution, AgCls is in equilibrium with Ag^ plus plus Cl^- gives Ksp = [Ag^ plus ][Cl^-] = s^2. For a salt MxXy, Ksp equals x^x y^y s^x plus y: for Ag 2CrO 4 it is 4 cubic seconds and for Ca 3PO 4 2 it is 108s to the power 5. AB type: Ksp equals s squared.
say.kn: ಅಲ್ಪ ದ್ರಾವ್ಯ ಲವಣದ ಸಂತೃಪ್ತ ದ್ರಾವಣದಲ್ಲಿ AgCl ಗೆ Ksp = [Ag⁺][Cl⁻] = s squared. M xXᵧ ಲವಣಕ್ಕೆ Ksp equals x to the power x y to the power y s^x plus y.

say.en: AB 2 or A 2B type: Ksp equals 4 cubic seconds.
A 3B 2 type: Ksp equals 108s to the power 5.
In a saturated solution of silver chloride, the solid is in equilibrium with its ions. If s moles dissolve per litre, Ksp equals s squared.
For a salt Mx Xy, Ksp is x to the x, y to the y, s to the x plus y. Silver chromate gives 4 s cubed; calcium phosphate 108 s to the fifth.
Common ion effect: in 0.1 molar sodium chloride, the chloride is already there, so silver chloride's solubility falls to 1.8 times 10 to the minus 9 molar, about 7500 times less.
If the ionic product Q is bigger than Ksp, a precipitate forms. If it is smaller, more solid can dissolve.

text.en: Q > Ksp: precipitate;  Q < Ksp: dissolves

say.en: Solubility product.

title.en: Ksp and the common ion effect

narration.en: For a 1:1 salt MX, Ksp = [M⁺][X⁻]. In pure water the solubility is S = √Ksp. Add a common ion (for AgCl, Cl⁻ from NaCl) and S falls sharply, because the product must still equal Ksp.
narration.kn: 1:1 ಲವಣ MX ಗೆ Ksp = [M⁺][X⁻]. ಶುದ್ಧ ನೀರಿನಲ್ಲಿ S = √Ksp. ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಅಯಾನು ಸೇರಿಸಿದರೆ S ತೀವ್ರವಾಗಿ ಇಳಿಯುತ್ತದೆ, ಏಕೆಂದರೆ ಗುಣಲಬ್ಧ Ksp ಗೆ ಸಮವಾಗಿರಬೇಕು.

say.kn: 1:1 ಲವಣ MX ಗೆ Ksp = [M⁺][X⁻]. ಶುದ್ಧ ನೀರಿನಲ್ಲಿ S equals the square root of Ksp. ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಅಯಾನು ಸೇರಿಸಿದರೆ S ತೀವ್ರವಾಗಿ ಇಳಿಯುತ್ತದೆ, ಏಕೆಂದರೆ ಗುಣಲಬ್ಧ Ksp ಗೆ ಸಮವಾಗಿರಬೇಕು.

body.en: The ionic product Q uses the actual ion concentrations. If Q > Ksp, a precipitate forms; if Q < Ksp, more solid can dissolve. A *common ion* lowers solubility: AgCl is far less soluble in NaCl solution than in pure water. This is used in salt analysis, for example in precipitating group cations selectively.
body.kn: ಅಯಾನಿಕ ಗುಣಲಬ್ಧ Q > Ksp ಆದರೆ ಅವಕ್ಷೇಪ ಉಂಟಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಅಯಾನ್ ದ್ರಾವ್ಯತೆಯನ್ನು ಕಡಿಮೆ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ; ಇದನ್ನು ಲವಣ ವಿಶ್ಲೇಷಣೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಬಳಸುತ್ತಾರೆ.

problem.en: Ksp of AgCl at 298 K is 1.8 × 10⁻¹⁰. Find its solubility in pure water and in 0.10 M NaCl.

steps.en: In water: Ksp = s², so s = √(1.8 × 10⁻¹⁰) ≈ 1.34 × 10⁻⁵ mol L⁻¹.
In 0.10 M NaCl: [Cl⁻] ≈ 0.10, so s = Ksp/0.10 = 1.8 × 10⁻⁹ mol L⁻¹.
The common ion lowers the solubility about 7,400 times.

answer.en: 1.34 × 10⁻⁵ M in water; 1.8 × 10⁻⁹ M in 0.10 M NaCl

narration.en: Let us solve this together. Ksp of AgCl at 298 K is 1.8 × 10⁻¹⁰. Find its solubility in pure water and in 0.10 M NaCl.

say.en: Let us solve this together. Ksp of AgCl at 298 kelvin is 1.8 times 10 to the power minus 10. Find its solubility in pure water and in 0.10 M NaCl.
In water: Ksp equals s squared, so s equals the square root of (1.8 times 10 to the power minus 10) is approximately 1.34 times 10 to the power minus 5 moles L to the power minus 1.
In 0.10 M NaCl: [Cl⁻] is approximately 0.10, so s equals Ksp/0.10 equals 1.8 times 10 to the power minus 9 moles L to the power minus 1.
The common ion lowers the solubility about 7,400 times.
So the answer is 1.34 times 10 to the power minus 5 M in water; 1.8 times 10 to the power minus 9 M in 0.10 M NaCl.

problem.en: Ksp of Ag₂CrO₄ is 1.1 × 10⁻¹². Find its molar solubility.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. Ksp of Ag₂CrO₄ is 1.1 × 10⁻¹². Find its molar solubility.

say.en: Let us solve this together. Ksp of Ag 2CrO 4 is 1.1 times 10 to the power minus 12. Find its molar solubility.
Ag 2CrO 4 is in equilibrium with 2Ag⁺ plus CrO 4 squared⁻: [Ag⁺] = 2 seconds, [CrO 4 squared⁻] = s.
Ksp equals 2 seconds squared s equals 4 cubic seconds equals 1.1 times 10 to the power minus 12.
s equals (2.75 times 10 to the power minus 13)^(1 over 3) is approximately 6.5 times 10 to the power minus 5 moles L to the power minus 1.
So the answer is s is approximately 6.5 times 10 to the power minus 5 moles L to the power minus 1.

narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. Ksp ಅಲ್ಪ ದ್ರಾವ್ಯ ಲವಣದ ಸಂತೃಪ್ತ ದ್ರಾವಣದ ಸಮತೋಲನ ಸ್ಥಿರಾಂಕ. MₓXᵧ ಗೆ Ksp = xˣ yʸ s^(x+y). ಅಯಾನಿಕ ಗುಣಲಬ್ಧ Ksp ಗಿಂತ ಹೆಚ್ಚಾದರೆ ಅವಕ್ಷೇಪ. ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಅಯಾನ್ ದ್ರಾವ್ಯತೆಯನ್ನು ಕಡಿಮೆ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ.

say.en: Let us recall the key ideas. Ksp is the equilibrium constant of a saturated solution of a sparingly soluble salt.
say.kn: ಮುಖ್ಯ ಅಂಶಗಳನ್ನು ನೆನಪಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳೋಣ. Ksp ಅಲ್ಪ ದ್ರಾವ್ಯ ಲವಣದ ಸಂತೃಪ್ತ ದ್ರಾವಣದ ಸಮತೋಲನ ಸ್ಥಿರಾಂಕ.

say.en: For M xXᵧ, Ksp equals x to the power x y to the power y s^x plus y.
say.kn: M xXᵧ ಗೆ Ksp equals x to the power x y to the power y s^x plus y.

say.en: Ionic product greater than Ksp means precipitation.
say.kn: ಅಯಾನಿಕ ಗುಣಲಬ್ಧ Ksp ಗಿಂತ ಹೆಚ್ಚಾದರೆ ಅವಕ್ಷೇಪ.

say.en: A common ion lowers solubility.
